name: 03-post-empty-field-no-results
description: An empty Field adds nothing to the select list (note the double space the MEL concatenation leaves: "SELECT id, name  from Contact where Name like '%young%'"); no matching records gives an empty list, rendered as []. README: 'Field: can be empty as Id field is displayed by default'.
